records.title: Imports of Fertilizers
details: b to d: Recently, the Union Cabinet has approved the proposal for setting up of a new Brownfield Ammonia-Urea Complex of 12.7 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT) annual capacity of Urea production within the existing premises of Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited (BCFCL), Namrup, Assam namely Assam Valley Fertilizer and Chemical Complany Ltd. (AVFCCL).
